product_safe_default.reason: The reviewed product default is safe for customer phase 1; exposing the tuning override as required would create deployment noise.

variables.name: MVP_ATTACHMENT_MAX_BYTES
variables.reason: The reviewed per-file upload limit is 10 MiB.

variables.name: MVP_ATTACHMENT_MAX_COUNT
variables.reason: The reviewed per-request attachment limit is five files.

variables.name: MVP_ATTACH_PREVIEW_TTL_SEC
variables.reason: The reviewed signed-preview lifetime is one hour.

variables.name: MVP_DASHBOARD_WINDOW_DAYS
variables.reason: The reviewed dashboard reporting window is 30 days.

variables.name: MVP_DEV_MODE
variables.reason: Omission keeps development login disabled.

variables.name: MVP_GOOGLE_TOKEN_URL
variables.reason: The standard Google OAuth token endpoint is the reviewed product default.

variables.name: MVP_GOOGLE_USERINFO_URL
variables.reason: The standard Google OpenID user-info endpoint is the reviewed product default.

variables.name: MVP_HUB_STALE_HOURS
variables.reason: The reviewed stale-work threshold is three hours.

variables.name: MVP_PORT
variables.reason: The reviewed non-privileged listen port is operator topology, not a customer-required choice.

variables.name: MVP_PUBLIC_MODE
variables.reason: Omission keeps the optional public-viewer mode disabled.

variables.name: MVP_RATE_LIMIT_AUTH_CAP
variables.reason: The reviewed authentication limit is ten requests per window.

variables.name: MVP_RATE_LIMIT_GENERAL_CAP
variables.reason: The reviewed general limit is 240 requests per window.

variables.name: MVP_RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS
variables.reason: The reviewed rate-limit window is one minute.

variables.name: MVP_RESTART_HEALTH_TIMEOUT_SEC
variables.reason: The reviewed post-restart health timeout is 20 seconds.

variables.name: MVP_SKIP_SERVE
variables.reason: Omission starts the HTTP server; the skip switch is test/operator-only.

variables.name: MVP_VAULT_GIT_HISTORY
variables.reason: The reviewed release enables vault history when the disable override is absent.

variables.name: MVP_VAULT_GIT_TIMEOUT_MS
variables.reason: The reviewed vault-history timeout is five seconds.

code_owned_fixed.reason: Customer phase 1 requires a fixed safety value supplied by the clean launcher rather than by the customer.

variables.name: MVP_GBRAIN_MODE
variables.reason: The clean launcher fixes GBrain off because the raw server omission default is not a safe disabled value.

test_only.reason: This deliberately injects a failure for regression tests and must never be part of a customer deployment contract.

variables.name: MVP_FAIL_ROUTER_WRITE
variables.reason: This deliberately makes router writes fail in tests.

customer_forbidden.reason: Customer mode currently requires GBrain to remain disabled, so this override is rejected instead of requested.

variables.name: MVP_GBRAIN_URL
variables.reason: Customer phase 1 has GBrain disabled and must not accept an internal service URL override.
